Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.debug

Class AnsiColor

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.debug.AnsiColor
public class AnsiColor extends Object
ANSI color codes for colorful console output. Provides easy-to-use color formatting for debug messages. Supports Windows console through Jansi library.
